prompts.erd:
Create a manufacturing edition of the referenced illustrated ERD. Reference image 1 is the style and layout source ONLY; replace every previous industry concept with the exact manufacturing model below. Use polished static Powtoon-style Redwood educational illustration: warm off-white paper, dark ink, restrained teal/coral table headers, friendly illustrated manufacturing worker, factory, machined bearing, caliper and production clipboard around edges. The visual must remain a readable ERD with exactly FIVE tables, FIVE one-to-many connectors. Portrait 3:4 high resolution. Title "SEER MANUFACTURING"; subtitle "The core data model". Layout: CUSTOMER_SITES top left, PLANTS top right, PRODUCTION_ORDERS middle left, COMPONENTS middle right, PRODUCTION_ORDER_LINES bottom center. Exact table text:
CUSTOMER_SITES: "PK  CUSTOMER_SITE_ID"; "SITE_NAME"; "REQUIREMENTS (JSON)".
PLANTS: "PK  PLANT_ID"; "PLANT_NAME"; "DAILY_CAPACITY_UNITS".
PRODUCTION_ORDERS: "PK  PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID"; "FK  CUSTOMER_SITE_ID"; "FK  PLANT_ID"; "SCHEDULED_START / DUE_DATE"; "ORDER_STATUS".
COMPONENTS: "PK  COMPONENT_ID"; "FK  PLANT_ID"; "MATERIAL_GRADE"; "PROCESS_ROUTE"; "UNIT_COST".
PRODUCTION_ORDER_LINES: "PK  ORDER_LINE_ID"; "FK  PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID"; "FK  COMPONENT_ID"; "QUANTITY"; "UNIT_COST / LINE_TOTAL".
Exactly five clean non-crossing connectors labeled 1 at parent and N at child: CUSTOMER_SITES->PRODUCTION_ORDERS; PLANTS->PRODUCTION_ORDERS; PLANTS->COMPONENTS; PRODUCTION_ORDERS->PRODUCTION_ORDER_LINES; COMPONENTS->PRODUCTION_ORDER_LINES.
Legend "PK = primary key     FK = foreign key     1:N = one-to-many". Footer "One plant per production order. Quantities are independent of scheduled dates." No extra entities, no wrong columns, no prior industry words or objects. Large legible precise typography. Characters and small workshop objects support the teaching story without obscuring table boxes.
prompts.intro: Create a wide 16:9 static illustrated opening scene for an Oracle LiveLabs manufacturing workshop. Use the two reference banners ONLY for character identity and illustration style: Jessica, long dark hair, sage jacket, dark trousers and tablet; Thomas, curly auburn hair, glasses, navy jacket and laptop. Preserve their recognizable appearances, with Powtoon-style Redwood editorial illustration, subtle paper texture, warm off-white background, muted sage, teal and terracotta. Scene: Jessica and Thomas stand at a production planning board overlooking a tidy machining cell with a CNC machine and tray of precision bearings. Jessica points to a dimensional inspection record; Thomas connects a production order to its component and plant on the board. Warm thoughtful working expressions; believable safe viewing area away from machinery. Meaningful diagrams on board but no tiny unreadable fake interface text. Main exact heading at top left "SEER MANUFACTURING". Exact secondary line "One component concern. One connected team." Three concise clearly printed board labels "Inspect the component", "Trace affected orders", "Plan the response". Spacious clear composition, same human character-led educational tone as the references, no glossy 3D rendering, no stock-photo realism, no robot, no glowing AI symbols, no invented dashboard screenshots. This is an illustrative story, not evidence of database execution.
